title: Payment timeout E104
text: Error code E104 indicates a payment gateway timeout. Retry with idempotency key and inspect upstream latency.

title: Card authorization decline
text: Card authorization can fail because of issuer decline, insufficient funds, fraud checks, or invalid card state.

title: Embedding search
text: Dense embeddings help retrieve semantically similar passages even when query wording differs from the indexed text.

title: BM25 exact matching
text: BM25 is useful for rare terms, product identifiers, error codes, names, and exact lexical evidence.

title: Hybrid retrieval
text: Hybrid retrieval combines lexical and semantic candidate sets. Reciprocal Rank Fusion can merge rankings without calibrating incompatible score scales.

title: Cross encoder reranking
text: A cross encoder jointly scores a query and candidate document and is typically more accurate but more expensive than bi-encoder retrieval.
